 L-R: Brad Pitt and Darius Marder 
 Getty/Josh Telles/Deadline 
 EXCLUSIVE: After the worldwide success of F1: The Movie, Brad Pitt and Apple Original Films have landed on their next project together. Sources tell Deadline that Apple has come aboard Connector , a new feature that will star Pitt. The Oscar winner also will serve as producer through his Plan B banner, with Sound of Metal director Darius Marder helming the pic, which is in development.

 News

 Penned by Marder and his sister Nina Marder, the film is set in 1970s New York and centers on a working-class legend: a skywalking ironworker who takes on forces larger than himself. Apple Studios will serve as the studio, and Pitt, Dede Gardner and Jeremy Kleiner will produce for Plan B. Darius Marder also will serve as producer.
 Pitt, Plan B and Marder had been discussing the project for some time. After the latest draft came in, Pitt was high on potentially making it the next thing he would shoot in 2027. As producers began looking for future homes, Apple made the most sense given the strong relationship with the streamer and Plan B from F1 and Wolfs .
 Watch on Deadline 
 RELATED: The 65 Movies That Have Made More Than $1 Billion At The Global Box Office 
 F1 became the highest-grossing sports feature of all time after its 2025 release and received a Best Picture Oscar nomination. Apple Original Films soon also also release a new Mark Wahlberg-led feature produced by Plan B and written and directed by Stephen Chbosky. Additionally, it was recently announced that Apple landed The Waffle House Index with Plan B attached to produce and Inde Navarrette attached to star.
 Pitt is coming off a strong fall that includes his Paramount survival thriller Heart of the Beast, which has grossed nearly $200 million at the worldwide box office. He also as The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth bowing over Thanksgiving. Next year comes the A24 pic The Riders directed by Edward Berger.
 RELATED: No ‘Cliff Booth’ At Cinemark: CEO Cites Long-Term Industry Risk 
 As for Marder, this marks his first feature since his directing debut on the 2020 pic Sound of Metal. The film earned six Academy Award nominations including Best Picture and Best Original Screenplay for Marder. It won Oscars for Best Sound and Best Film Editing.
 Pitt is represented by CAA and Brillstein Entertainment Partners. Marder is represented by CAA, 42 and Greg Slewett at JSSK.
